subject: Announcement: wallace v2 publication in Early View!

messages.author: 881c0dd9c7b0d196
messages.subject: Announcement: wallace v2 publication in Early View!
parts:
Exciting news from the Wallace Team!

Our software note in Ecography announcing the release of version 2 and its advancements since the initial release of Wallace is available for Early View!
http://doi.org/10.1111/ecog.06547

Installing Wallace V2
v2 is on CRAN and can be installed using:
install.packages("wallace")
library(wallace)
run_wallace()

A vignette for using this version is found here: Wallace v2 Vignette

If you wish to continue to use v1, see the instructions below...
Instruction for installing previous versions of Wallace (v1)
If you want to install the previous version of Wallace (v1), you have three options to install it in your machine. 
  1. Install from CRAN using the following line of code:
    remotes::install_version("wallace", version = "1.1.3", repos = "http://cran.us.r-project.org")
  2. Install from Github using the following line of code:
    remotes::install_github("wallaceecomod/wal...@v1.1.3") 
  3. Install the v1 docker image. Please see the “Docker Image and Tools for Cloud Implementations” section for more information.
Thanks for your continued support & bug testing.
Happy Modeling!
- Bethany & the Wallace Team
